description: jQuery Tags Input Plugin 1.3.3 - a plugin for managing tags input fields with features like autosize, add/remove tags, and autocomplete.

methods.name: doAutosize
methods.description: Automatically adjusts the width of the input field based on its content.

methods.name: resetAutosize
methods.description: Resets the autosize parameters and initializes the autosize feature.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Adds a new tag to the input field, with options for focus and callback.

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: Removes a specified tag from the input field.

methods.name: tagExist
methods.description: Checks if a tag already exists in the input field.

methods.name: importTags
methods.description: Clears existing tags and imports new tags from a string.

methods.name: tagsInput
methods.description: Initializes the tags input plugin with specified options.

methods.name: updateTagsField
methods.description: Updates the underlying input field with the current list of tags.
